profile.headline: Lead Software Developer | Java Spring MicroServices Developer, Web Applications
profile.summary:
With over 30 years of experience in software development, I am a passionate and proficient Lead Software Developer. I design, develop, and deploy web applications using cloud technologies, Java and Spring. 

I have a strong background in micro-services architectures, and I have acquired multiple certifications in Spring and Java. I enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our clients and users. I have a passion for XTreme programming principles including TDD and paired programming.
